name: Single Permit (Temporary Residence + Work Permit Combined)

requirements.blocker_text: A confirmed employment offer/contract with a Slovak employer.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Slovak-registered employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer reports the vacancy to the Labour Office as part of the single-permit process.

outcome.duration_length: typically tied to the employment contract's duration

sources.title: Ministry of Labour, Social Affairs and Family of the Slovak Republic -- employment of third-country nationals: single permit combining work authorization and temporary residence, Labour Office vacancy reporting requirement
